projection: Equirectangular, x=(lon-90.4185)*272.45*0.9246, y=(24.3887-lat)*272.45; same coordinate system as map.json (stage 2 district map), cropped here to Chittagong and Cox's Bazar districts.
credit: Boundaries: geoBoundaries gbOpen Bangladesh ADM2/ADM3/ADM4 (CC BY 3.0 IGO), boundary year 2020, derived from Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics data via OCHA ROAP; simplified for the web. Runfola et al. (2020), PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.
notes: Upazila boundaries are the 2015 BBS set: Karnaphuli and Eidgaon upazilas have no separate polygon (Karnaphuli lies inside Patiya, Eidgaon inside Cox's Bazar Sadar) and Fatikchhari/Bhujpur thana is not split.
metro_thanas are the ADM3 shapes inside the Chittagong City Corporation area; names follow geoBoundaries spelling except Bayazid Bostami.
